questions.stem: Which version of SHA belongs to Secure Hash Algorithm
questions.explanation: SHA family includes SHA-0/1/2/3 variants covered in the material.

questions.stem: The secure hash algorithm takes as input a message with a maximum length less than 264 bits and produces a ________ bit message digest.
questions.explanation: SHA-1 input limit is < 2^64 bits; listed sizes are digest lengths, not the max input.
